title: Can the curve identify the mechanism?
promptMarkdown: An ideal initial-rate experiment identifies K_M=30 μM and k₂=12 s⁻¹ using a separately measured E_T. Construct two different positive pairs (k₁,k₋₁) consistent with these results. An inhibitor at [I]=40 μM has K_I=20 μM and follows the stipulated competitive model. Calculate its apparent K_M and the ratio v_inhibited/v_control at [S]=30 and 300 μM. Explain which conclusions require extra assumptions and propose an independent measurement.
hintLadder: Solve the equation for k−1 after choosing k1.
Cancel the common Vmax S in the rate ratio.
Identical macroscopic combinations need not imply identical microscopic parameters.
